file_insights.purpose: Comprehensive iOS architecture strategy guide capturing MASTER_PROMPT variant A (iOS-only) output
key_sections: Detection Phase - Stack detection via Package.swift
Phase 0 - Validation/POC with deliverables and risks
Phase 1 - Core architecture setup (modularization, SwiftUI patterns, DI, native integrations)
Architecture rules for Claude Code enforcement
Feature spec template for AI generation
Code review checklists and testing strategies

patterns_discovered.description: Project detection via Package.swift → automatic selection of iOS-only variant
patterns_discovered.instance: Stack detection phase identifies Swift 5.9, iOS 17+, SwiftUI, no Android artifacts

patterns_discovered.description: SPM-based package structure with feature isolation and protocol-based dependencies
patterns_discovered.instance: Each feature = 1 SPM package in /Packages/, dependency direction: App → Features → CoreKit → DesignSystem

patterns_discovered.description: iOS 17+ observation pattern replacing ObservableObject for cleaner state management
patterns_discovered.instance: ViewModels marked with @Observable, Views use @State private var viewModel

patterns_discovered.description: Services abstracted via protocols, real and mock implementations for testability
Type-safe navigation via AppRoute enum and NavigationCoordinator
patterns_discovered.instance: NavigationCoordinator with path management, navigationDestination(for: AppRoute.self)

patterns_discovered.description: SwiftData for local storage with sync coordination and conflict resolution
patterns_discovered.instance: Item model with SyncStatus enum, SyncCoordinator orchestrating push/pull

patterns_discovered.description: Architecture rules and feature templates documented for AI-assisted code generation
patterns_discovered.instance: ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md enforcing module structure, patterns, testing requirements

gotchas_discovered.risk: Circular dependencies, increased build times with multi-package setup
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Strict dependency graph enforcement, CoreKit as single dependency point

gotchas_discovered.risk: Migration from ObservableObject patterns requires retraining; API surface differs
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Architecture rules document enforces pattern, code review checklist catches violations

gotchas_discovered.risk: Generated code may use deprecated Swift APIs, wrong HealthKit usage, incorrect SwiftData syntax
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Strict architecture rules, concrete code examples as reference patterns, Swift version pinning

gotchas_discovered.risk: State restoration, deep link handling, route parameter type safety
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Router-based pattern with typed AppRoute enum, explicit coordinator management

gotchas_discovered.risk: Last-write-wins vs. custom merge logic, concurrent local/remote changes
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: SyncCoordinator abstraction allows swappable strategies, SyncStatus enum tracks state

gotchas_discovered.risk: Target 16ms/frame (60fps); feature additions can exceed budget with improper async/await
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Instruments Time Profiler mandated, performance phase (Phase 5) with benchmarking

gotchas_discovered.risk: HealthKit, location, calendar permissions can block UI or be requested at wrong time
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Abstraction pattern isolates permission logic, feature boundary injection ensures proper timing

approach_details.execution: MASTER_PROMPT variant detection triggered iOS-only path (Package.swift detection), generated phased implementation strategy with working code examples
approach_details.completeness: Comprehensive 7-phase roadmap from POC validation through production optimization, spanning architecture, testing, CI/CD, performance, security, and native integrations
approach_details.artifact_quality: Production-ready guidance with concrete Swift code patterns, module diagrams, protocol definitions, and integration hooks for Claude Code automation

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit type-safe routing with associated values for complex feature navigation parameters
recommendations.rationale: Current AppRoute enum uses raw cases; associated values (e.g., case featureB(id: String)) enable compile-time safety and eliminate runtime route parsing

recommendations.recommendation: Expand Phase 4 testing strategy to include snapshot testing framework (e.g., SnapshotTesting) and ViewModel state machine validation
recommendations.rationale: ViewModels have complex state transitions; state machine testing catches edge cases in loading/error states

recommendations.recommendation: Add explicit thread safety guidelines for concurrent access to SwiftData models and SyncCoordinator state
recommendations.rationale: Async/await + background sync can cause data races; document MainActor requirements and serialization

recommendations.recommendation: Add security phase covering API credential management, encrypted storage for sensitive data, and HTTPS pinning for sync
recommendations.rationale: SyncCoordinator pushes/pulls data without documented encryption or validation strategy

recommendations.recommendation: Include DesignSystem accessibility requirements: VoiceOver labels, dynamic type scaling, color contrast ratios
recommendations.rationale: Architecture rules enforce patterns but don't mandate a11y; should be non-negotiable

recommendations.recommendation: Document iOS version fallback strategy for @Observable (iOS 16 requires ObservableObject shim)
recommendations.rationale: iOS 17+ assumption locks out users; provide abstraction if broader version support needed

recommendations.recommendation: Add Phase 1 troubleshooting guide for common SPM build failures (cache corruption, dependency resolution)
recommendations.rationale: SPM can be opaque; early documentation prevents onboarding friction
